name: Gingen an der Fils (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and white, charged below the centre with the municipal arms of Gingen an der Fils (a blue wavy bend and a red church on white).
history: The arms were adopted in 1922; the blue-white flag was granted by the Ministry of the Interior on 5 December 1958.

features.role: Gingen an der Fils arms — wavy bend and church
